name: sticky-hero-section

frames.best_why: Both screens are on show at once, the dark one tilted over the shrinking light one with all four photos visible.

tagline: Two full-screen panels tilt and shrink as the dark one rises over the light.
summary: A pale headline screen pinned in place shrinks and tips back while a dark second screen scales up and levels out over it, ending as a building gallery with four photos.
appearance: A pale grey page with faint grid lines and a centred black headline, then a near-black screen with the same grid, a bold white heading and four architecture photos in a row. The two page edges meet at a slight angle while they overlap.
behaviour: Scrolling down pulls the light screen to four fifths and rotates it back a few degrees while the dark screen grows from slightly small and straightens on top of it. At the end the dark gallery owns the viewport with the light page behind it.
demo_content: Headlines Ship the page your product deserves and Buildings that outlive the trends, plus four building photos.
search_phrases: two full screens sliding over each other on scroll
page sections that tilt and shrink
hero that scales away as you scroll
stacked landing sections with a 3d tilt
use_when: A landing page wants a dramatic hand-off from a headline screen to a content screen.
avoid_when: It is only two fixed screens with no props, and the four photos sit in a row that never wraps.
customise: No props: both headlines, the subline, the four photos and the two colour gradients are written into the two sections in the file.
weight_why: Four remote photos and two scroll transforms on whole screens.

a11y.note: Photos use the placeholder alt text img, and the scale and rotate transforms ignore reduced-motion.

issues: Every photo's alt text is literally img.
The grey subline under the hero is very small and low contrast.
Frames 5 and 6 bring the light screen back above the dark one, so the clip's final state is ambiguous.
polish_why: Crisp type on a subtle grid with a smooth page tilt; tiny subline and placeholder alt text.
title: Sticky Hero Section
